criteria.statement: With the template settings (`publishArtifacts: true`), the resolver prints exactly `publish: on` and exits 0 for each of these 4 kinds: `trd`, `report`, `design`, `design-system`
criteria.cites: Intended Change, After item 1 (lines 13-16), item 2 (lines 17-20)
criteria.evidence: CLI transcript: four `artifacts.js publish --kind <K> --settings <template settings>` runs, each showing stdout `publish: on` and exit code 0

criteria.statement: With the template settings, `publish --kind prd` prints `publish: off (off by default for prd: pass --publish to publish it)` and exits 0 — today's behaviour would have published it
criteria.cites: Intended Change, After items 1-2 (lines 13-20); Checks, line 44-45
criteria.evidence: CLI transcript of `artifacts.js publish --kind prd --settings <template settings>` showing that exact line and exit 0

criteria.statement: With the template settings, each of these 6 kinds resolves `publish: off (off by default for <K>: pass --publish to publish it)` with exit 0: `audit-prd`, `audit-trd`, `verification-report`, `audit-build`, a check-skill kind (e.g. `verify-design-comparison`), and a kind no default names (e.g. `no-such-kind`)

criteria.evidence: CLI transcript: six resolver runs, each showing the off line naming its own kind, exit 0

criteria.statement: When the settings file is missing, or exists but is unreadable / not valid JSON, the resolver resolves to the defaults: `--kind trd` prints `publish: on` and `--kind prd` prints the off-by-default line, exit 0 in both cases
criteria.cites: Intended Change, After item 1 (line 16: "A missing or unreadable settings file resolves to the default")
criteria.evidence: CLI transcript: `--settings <nonexistent path>` and `--settings <file containing invalid JSON>`, each run for `trd` and `prd`

criteria.statement: Each of these 4 values of `ensemble.publishArtifacts` resolves to the defaults alone (`trd` on, `prd` off by default): `true`, key absent, `null`, a non-object value such as `"yes"` or `1`
criteria.cites: Intended Change, After item 2 (line 20: "`true`, absent, `null` or any non-object value → the defaults alone")
criteria.evidence: CLI transcript: one settings fixture per value, resolver run for `trd` and `prd` against each

criteria.statement: With `publishArtifacts: false`, `publish --kind trd` prints exactly `publish: off (publishArtifacts is false)`, and the same line is printed when `--requested` is added, for a default-on kind (`trd`) and a default-off kind (`prd`)
criteria.cites: Intended Change, After item 1 (lines 14-15), item 2 (line 17: "setting `false` → off (always, `--requested` included)"); Checks, lines 45-46
criteria.evidence: CLI transcript against a `{"ensemble":{"publishArtifacts":false}}` fixture: `--kind trd`, `--kind trd --requested`, `--kind prd --requested`, each printing the false line

criteria.statement: When the setting is not `false`, `--requested` turns a kind on regardless of its default or of a per-kind object: `--kind prd --requested` with the template settings prints `publish: on`, and `--kind trd --requested` with `{"publishArtifacts":{"trd":false}}` prints `publish: on`
criteria.cites: Intended Change, After item 2 (line 18: "`--requested` → on", ordered before the object rule)
criteria.evidence: CLI transcript of both runs

criteria.statement: An object setting naming a kind with a boolean decides that kind: `{"prd": true}` makes `--kind prd` print `publish: on`; `{"trd": false}` makes `--kind trd` print `publish: off (set false for trd in publishArtifacts)`; a kind the object does not name, or names with a non-boolean value, falls back to its default
criteria.cites: Intended Change, After item 1 (lines 15-16, the reason string), item 2 (lines 18-19: "object naming `K` with a boolean → that value; otherwise `PUBLISH_DEFAULTS[K]`")
criteria.evidence: CLI transcript against object fixtures: `{"prd":true}` for `prd`; `{"trd":false}` for `trd`; `{"prd":true}` for `trd` (on by default); `{"trd":"no"}` for `trd` (on by default)
